meta.name: Yuzu 表情プロンプト
meta.description: Yuzu（オリジナルキャラクター）用の表情差分プロンプト集。Whisk の画像生成（参照画像アップロード→image-to-image モデル化）での利用を想定。
meta.author: GitHub Copilot
meta.usage_notes: まずは各エントリの `combined_prompt` を試し、必要に応じて `positives` を組み合わせてください。ネガティブトークンは必ず含めてください。
meta.image_model_usage: Upload the reference image at `doc/02_Characters/images/Yuzu/yuzu.png` to Whisk, create/use an image model for Yuzu, and use image-to-image generation where possible.

color_preservation.instruction: Preserve reference image color balance; do not apply per-expression color tints (e.g., no blue or warm overlay). Maintain natural skin tone and global color grading consistent with the reference image.

pose_preservation.instruction: Preserve reference head pose and camera angle — do NOT change face orientation, rotation, or head tilt. Use `doc/02_Characters/images/Yuzu/yuzu.png` as the pose reference.

ribbon_preservation.instruction: Ensure Yuzu's ribbon is placed on the viewer-left side of the image (character's right). Do NOT place ribbon on the viewer-right side; if multiple ribbons appear, primary ribbon must remain viewer-left.

cutout_defaults.note_jp: 切り抜き用の太めの白いストローク（被写体の輪郭に沿うアウトライン、推奨 18–24px、ここでは 20px）を必ず付与してください。※四隅の矩形枠ではなく、被写体に沿った均一なストロークにしてください。被写体+ストロークが画像端から24px以上の余裕を持つことを確認し、基準マークはストロークの外側（右下）に小さな黒 8×8 px を配置してください。透過ではなく白背景で出力してください。

expressions.combined_prompt: Yuzu, single character only (solo subject, one person), full-body anime character, centered, portrait/vertical composition (tall), standing pose with relaxed natural stance and slight forward lean, warm small open-mouth smile (slight upper teeth), very large sparkling eyes with layered catchlights, cute pastel outfit (e.g., peter-pan collar or frilled blouse + A-line / pleated skirt, or cardigan + skirt; knee or ankle socks, loafers or mary-janes — NOT a hoodie/hooded sweatshirt and NOT a sailor school uniform). **Enforce colors:** clothes base clearly #fff4f2, trims #e9ddff; **place a single prominent hair ribbon attached to the hair at the temple on viewer-left (character's right) saturated #ff9fb6 (bright glossy hair accessory)**; ribbon must be single, hair-mounted, medium size (not oversized), anchored to hair (no floating ribbons) and not on chest/torso. Accent #ff9fb6 must be used only for hair ribbon, cheek highlights, and small accessories; do NOT place ribbon on the chest or torso. Clean lineart, high detail, crisp silhouette, full-body visible (head-to-toe), soft warm studio lighting that enhances hair ribbon and face highlights, plain soft mid-gray background, include a thick white silhouette stroke (outline) 18–24px (prefer 20px) that follows the subject's silhouette (not a rectangular cornered border); ensure the subject+stroke has at least a 24px margin to the image edge; place a small black registration mark (8x8px square) outside the stroke at the bottom-right corner; no transparent background, preserve natural skin tone and realistic proportions; do NOT blur, censor, or pixelate the face (no mosaic, no face blur); ensure hair ribbon on viewer-left (character's right) and do NOT place ribbon on viewer-right side or on the chest. Do NOT generate multiple people, duplicates, clones, or extra characters. Use portrait orientation (vertical) — resolution 2048x3072 (tall) and compose subject centrally; ensure clear head-to-toe visibility.
expressions.notes_jp: シンプル版：単体（single character / single subject）で高品質出力を優先します。縦長（portrait）構図での出力（resolution=2048x3072）を明示しました。設定は steps=48, cfg_scale=13 を推奨。複数体が出る場合はネガティブに 'multiple characters' / 'duplicates' / 'multiple people' を追加してください。画質を上げたい場合は生成後に 2×アップスケールまたは img2img（トリミング＋denoising 0.20–0.40）で局所修正してください。シード固定で再現性を確保してください.

expressions.combined_prompt: Use reference image (init) for pose/color. Yuzu, anime-style portrait, clean lineart, calm neutral expression, relaxed eyes, soft lighting; preserve clothing colors (Primary #fff4f2 base, Secondary #e9ddff trims) and ribbon highlight #ff9fb6 limited to ribbon/cheeks; plain mid-gray background, thick white silhouette stroke (18-24px) following the subject silhouette (not a rectangular border); ensure the subject+stroke has at least a 24px margin to the image edge; place a small black registration mark (8x8px square) outside the stroke at bottom-right, high detail, crisp silhouette, preserve natural skin tone and head pose (do NOT change face orientation or head tilt), ribbon on viewer-left (character's right)
expressions.notes_jp: img2img 用テンプレート。init_image に全身リファレンスを指定し、denoising_strength ≒ 0.30–0.45 を推奨。アクセント #ff9fb6 はリボン・頬に限定。

expressions.notes_jp: img2img 用微笑み。init image に全身リファレンスを指定し色のブレを抑えてください。
